handoff.salientSummary: Implemented the App Reservations Setup UI (`settings*.tsx`), full-screen Floor Plan Designer (`FloorPlanCanvas`), Location Settings Reservations status card + time-zone nudge, Arabic RTL translations (`ar.po`), guard/unit/component tests, and Playwright E2E spec (`reservations-setup.test.ts`), verified across both US (`acme`) and KSA (`riyadh-grill`, `?lng=ar`) tenants.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
Implemented the App Reservations Setup UI and Floor Plan Designer for milestone `foh-core`:
1. Updated `apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/settings+/locations.$locationId.tsx` to render the Reservations status card (`[data-testid="location-reservations-status-card"]`) and deep link (`/reservations/settings?location=<id>`) when `reservations.enabled` is true, and to fire `notifyReservationsContextChanged(organization.id, 'locations')` when location settings are saved.
2. Updated `apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/_layout.tsx` to accept `?location=` as an alias for `?locationId=` so deep links from Location settings pre-select the target location.
3. Created `apps/app/app/utils/reservations/setup-api.ts` providing typed DTOs, request/response normalizers bridging `tenant-api` and App UI models, grid/canvas/rotation/time/contiguity helpers, conflict/error extractors, and browser-direct `fetch` functions for `/operator/reservations/setup/locations/:locationId/*`.
4. Implemented `apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/settings.tsx` parent shell route with sub-tab navigation (General & Policies, Tables & Areas, Floor Plan Designer, Services & Turn Times, Special Days & Blocks), location switcher, read-only badge, and the time-zone mismatch banner (`[data-testid="setup-timezone-mismatch-banner"]`) that calls `POST .../timezone/re-derive`.
5. Implemented `settings._index.tsx` (General & Policies), `settings.tables.tsx` (Dining Areas, Tables, and Table Combinations CRUD with 409 future-reservation conflict listing), `settings.services.tsx` (Services CRUD with cross-midnight validation, contiguous Turn-Time rules editor, Pacing rules, and Service Availability windows), and `settings.special-days.tsx` (Special Days & Holidays and Table/Area Blocks with 409 conflicting reservation surfacing and force-override).
6. Implemented `apps/app/app/components/reservations/floor-plan-canvas.tsx` and `settings.floor-plan.tsx` providing a full-screen local-draft floor-plan editor with `dir="ltr"` canvas and viewport, area tabs, 10-unit grid snap drag and resize, rotation presets (0/90/180/270) and custom angle input, keyboard arrow nudge (`+1` unit, `Shift+Arrow` `+10` units) with `aria-live="polite"` coordinate announcements, decor elements (`wall`, `bar`, `door`, `window`, `label`, `plant`, `zone`), explicit Save, Leave-without-saving confirmation/discard, 409 stale-version conflict banner, and read-only mode.
7. Extracted and translated all 310 new Lingui messages into Arabic (`apps/app/app/locales/ar.po`), added unit/component/guard tests, and added Playwright E2E spec `apps/app/tests/e2e/reservations-setup.test.ts`.
